notes: v9.2 / display Rev V3.2 (2026-08-30) — THREE CHANGES per Stephen. (1) CONSUMABLES SPLIT BY PO MEMO: a purchase is TRUE consumable cage material ONLY when the buyer typed 'cons' in the PO memo/summary (regex CONS excluding CONSTRUCT, case-insensitive); it then counts consumed on receipt WHEREVER it landed — measured live T90: 25 of 29 cons-memo POs arrive through GOETTL WAREHOUSE JOB HOLDING, only 3 land in the cage warehouses, so the MEMO is the classifier, not the location. Cage-warehouse purchases WITHOUT the memo are par-level inventory stock restock -> Received into stock (labeled 'par restock'). Engine reads new OPTIONAL in/po_meta.json (sixth Genie pull: purchase_order_number, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_summary, memo — number+MAX aggregates, trailing-92 LV; a dedicated small CONS-only query guarantees completeness because the statement API truncates at 5,000 rows) and stamps ledger Receipt/PO rows cons=1 + consm=<memo>. Absent file -> cons_armed False, honest warning, template falls back to the v9.1 all-cage-consumable location rule. Verified on live data through 08-29: 28 cons receipts / $24,917.75 vs 51 par-restock receipts / $92,853.20 reclassified to stock. (2) FLEET TO-DO CARDS ENRICHED + CLICKABLE REFERENCES: every fleet card (anomaly / added / removed / driver change) shows prior->current value and vehicle #, plus a collapsible 'Movement behind this' table of every ledger transaction touching that truck in the snapshot window (date, type, PO/ADJ/XFR reference, vendor/tech, route, job, $/qty). PO references are ServiceTitan deep links via #/EditInvoice/<internal id> (DATA.poid map from po_meta; bare-numeric vendor POs are their own id), job #s use the existing stLink, and the card title links the truck via #/new/inventory/inventory-locations/trucks/details/<TruckId> (roster TruckId; URL patterns supplied by Stephen 2026-08-30). Zero ledger events on a swing renders an explicit 'came from counts/valuation' note. PO/Doc columns in What Left / What Came In are clickable too (2,488 links on the 08-29 dataset). Adjustment deep links NOT built — no internal adjustment id exists in any feed (ST export would need an Adjustment ID column). meScore, key formats, close gate, export sheet shapes, JH quarantine, $500 pre-approval scope all UNCHANGED. Verified headless on real data through 08-29: 28/28 checks (v9.0 gate set + v9.2 additions), zero pageerrors, reconciliations tie <$0.011, approve round-trip exact. Engine change is ADDITIVE (po_meta reader + row stamping + poid/consArmed/stTruckBase in DATA + census fields cons_armed/cons_pos/cons_cage_rows/poid_map). (3) WAREHOUSE TO-DO EVIDENCE (same session, second pass): EVERY explain-&-approve card — warehouse adjustments (window + month), scratch & dent, standing residuals/dead locations, and Job Holding pass-through — now carries the same collapsible 'Movement behind this' table the fleet cards got: the item's OWN ledger row first (highlighted, its job # deep-linked) plus every transaction touching that location within ±7 days (standing items: the month), PO references deep-linked via DATA.poid. Verified headless on real data through 08-29: 53/53 warehouse cards carry evidence, 184 PO links inside card evidence, self-row highlight renders, zero adjustment links without aid, reconciliations tie, approve round-trip exact, zero pageerrors. (4) ADJUSTMENT DEEP LINKS LIVE (same session, third pass): no feed carries the internal adjustment id, so it was harvested number->id from the ServiceTitan adjustments list via the browser (280 pairs, #2971-#3252, 2026-08-30) into adjmap.json — engine reads it from the input dir (optional; 'Adjustment ID' export column still wins if ever added), stamps row.aid, and the template links via #/new/inventory/adjustments/details/<id>.
